proofModel: CKRA-informed: manifest intent is desired state only; accepted state requires structured writer output, live FormList readback, verifier evidence, and a gate summary.

scope.questStageFillScope: Blocked until exact quest/stage metadata is approved and declared; receiver exact-stage support exists but no quest-stage entries are live-approved.
scope.nonP2FillScope: Audit/design only for source classes outside the all-race P2 receiver/FormList network.

runtimeRouteProof.boundary: Accepted-route log proof only. Wrong-origin rejection, generic-source silence, Survey/status clarity, stack snapshots, and true feel remain manual/runtime gates.

approvalRules: Only exact source records with local extracted/readback evidence can be approved.
Approved entries must name receiver, sourceKind, accepted context, rejected context, duplicate guard, and rationale.
Quest-stage sources require exact approved stages before live fill.
Book entries are one-shot per source/form/family through PDV_PlayerEvents repeat gates.
Do not approve duplicate abbreviated books, broad lore-only books, shrine blessings, spell effects, generic faction records, or generic quest records in this pass.
